batteryremapper.description:
BatteryRemapper is an Xposed/LSPosed module with a Material 3 companion app that remaps Android's battery percentage to a customizable physical battery range.

Features:
- Custom battery range mapping, such as 20%–80%.
- Battery percentage remapping across System UI, quick settings, and lock screen.
- Live LSPosed hook status detection.
- Automatic Battery Saver control with configurable hysteresis.
- Optional automatic shutdown protection at a chosen battery level.
- Charger detection to cancel shutdown and disable Battery Saver.
- Root-enabled System UI restart option.
- Rootless configuration sharing between the app and System UI module.
- Material 3 interface with light/dark theme support.
- About screen with version, license, repository, and credits.

Requires LSPosed or a compatible Xposed framework.

Target Scope: System UI (com.android.systemui)
